name: longtail-dev-20
purpose: Development set for providers with no folder in providers/: 20 public repos that call smaller APIs (15 providers) through raw HTTP, an SDK, GraphQL or a webhook handler, each pinned to a commit where an officially announced deprecation, retirement or breaking change is still pending. It needs a watcher for providers with no folder (F4's anyProviderWatcher) to run; until one is passed to the runner, each repo stops before any spend.
criteria: Curated by hand on 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03, not recovered from Refit's history. Candidates came from GitHub code search for the deprecated endpoint, field, SDK or header of each change. Kept: public, not archived, not a fork, under about 50 MB, a root package.json (npm, yarn or pnpm) or requirements.txt/pyproject.toml; the deprecated usage reachable at the default-branch HEAD commit recorded here; no secret on a call-site line; and a short exact quote from the provider's own deprecation, retirement or changelog page. Every callSites line was read at the pinned commit (re-check with `node evals/sets/check-callsites.ts longtail-dev-20`), and every quote was re-read on its page on 2026-11-03 (two are the opening or closing words of a longer sentence). Not compared with the sealed sets, which stay unopened; none of the 15 providers is one the sealed sets were built for. Repos are ordered by SHA-256 of "longtail-dev-20:<owner/name>" (lower-cased), so a run with a small cap reaches them in an order nobody picked.

pendingChange.title: Firebase Dynamic Links (shortLinks REST API) shut down

source.quote: On August 25th, 2025, Firebase Dynamic Links will shut down.

repos.migration: Firebase short links are dead; remove the Firebase generator and make bitly or is.gd the default in scripts/lib/_getShortService.js.

pendingChange.title: Universal Analytics sunset (Measurement Protocol v1 /collect)

source.quote: Universal Analytics has sunset and is no longer available as of July 1, 2024.

repos.migration: Rewrite postReq and gaRequiredPayload for GA4 Measurement Protocol (/mp/collect, measurement_id + api_secret, events JSON) in place of the UA hit.

pendingChange.title: Coinbase Pro API (api.pro.coinbase.com) disabled; migrate to Advanced Trade

source.quote: Coinbase Pro has been disabled for use

repos.migration: Repoint _get_price_coinbase_pro from api.pro.coinbase.com (503 when checked 2026-11-02) to a live public candles endpoint such as api.exchange.coinbase.com/products/{pair}/candles or Advanced Trade public market data.

pendingChange.title: PayPal Payments v1 (/v1/payments, wrapped by paypal-rest-sdk payment.create/execute) deprecated in favour of v2

source.quote: The /v1/payments endpoint is deprecated.

repos.migration: Replace payment.create (intent sale, approval_url link) in GET /checkout/:cartId and payment.execute (paymentId + PayerID) in GET /payment/success with Orders v2 create-order (intent CAPTURE, purchase_units) and capture-by-order-id, through PayPal's current server SDK or plain REST.

pendingChange.title: Bing Search APIs (v7.0) retired

source.quote: Bing Search APIs will be retired on August 11, 2025.

callSites.text: const { query, limit = 10, safeSearch = 0, page = 1, apiUrl = 'https://api.bing.microsoft.com/v7.0/search', apiKey, language } = options;

repos.migration: Bing Web Search v7 has no drop-in REST successor (Microsoft points to Grounding with Bing Search in Azure AI Agents), so retire or re-back the 'bing' provider and its default apiUrl.

pendingChange.title: Slack verification tokens deprecated in favour of signed requests (signing secret, X-Slack-Signature)

source.quote: Signing secrets replace the old verification tokens.

callSites.text: const { text, token, channel_id: channelId, user_id: userId } = req.body;

repos.migration: Replace the body-token checks in the /polls slash-command and /hook interactivity handlers with X-Slack-Signature verification: an HMAC-SHA256 over v0:{X-Slack-Request-Timestamp}:{raw body} keyed with a signing secret. That needs the raw urlencoded body kept before express.urlencoded parses it; jest tests are in __tests__/.

pendingChange.title: Slack files.upload retired in favour of files.getUploadURLExternal + files.completeUploadExternal (files_upload_v2)

source.quote: The files.upload API method has been deprecated.

repos.migration: Move from slackclient 2.5.0 (module slack) to slack_sdk and swap files_upload(channels="#tableau-test", ...) for files_upload_v2, which needs a channel ID rather than a #name; then re-check how url_private is read from the v2 response. The script calls Tableau2Slack() at module level.

pendingChange.title: Coinbase Pro API (api.pro.coinbase.com) disabled; migrate to Advanced Trade

source.quote: Coinbase Pro has been disabled for use

repos.migration: Replace coinbase-pro AuthenticatedClient/WebsocketClient and the hand-signed CB-ACCESS-* axios client with the Advanced Trade API (api.coinbase.com/api/v3/brokerage, CDP keys/JWT); the other two strategy files repeat the pattern.

pendingChange.title: Twitch legacy WebSub webhooks (helix/webhooks/hub, users/follows topic) decommissioned in favour of EventSub

source.quote: Decommissioned WebSub-based webhooks, which resulted in the following documentation changes:

callSites.text: webhookRouter.post('/follow', Twitch.validateWebhook, async (request: Request, response: Response) => {

repos.migration: Subscribe through POST /helix/eventsub/subscriptions (channel.follow v2 with moderator_user_id; stream.online/offline in place of the streams topic) and verify Twitch-Eventsub-Message-Signature instead of x-hub-signature. Answer webhook_callback_verification with the JSON challenge instead of hub.challenge, and read event.user_name instead of data[0].from_name. The same pattern is on /webhooks/stream; mocha tests.

pendingChange.title: Riot summoner-v4 /lol/summoner/v4/summoners/by-name deprecated (Riot ID migration) in favour of account-v1 by-riot-id + summoner-v4 by-puuid

source.quote: We recommend no longer using these endpoints (deprecated):

callSites.text: const response: RiotResponse = await fetchSummoner(name, region, process.env.RIOT_API_TOKEN);

repos.migration: Resolve players through account-v1 /riot/account/v1/accounts/by-riot-id/{gameName}/{tagLine} on the regional host, then summoner-v4 /summoners/by-puuid/{puuid}, so fetchSummoner takes a Riot ID instead of a summoner name. The quoted list (page dated 2023-10-16) names /lol/summoner/v4/summoners/by-name/{summonerName}. Serverless TypeScript app with a lint script only.

pendingChange.title: The Graph hosted service (api.thegraph.com/subgraphs/name/...) shut down

source.quote: As of June 12th, 2024, the hosted service is no longer active.

repos.migration: Send the ENS domains GraphQL query to The Graph Network gateway (gateway.thegraph.com/api/<API_KEY>/subgraphs/id/<ENS subgraph id>), with the key coming from a Worker secret/env instead of the hard-coded hosted-service URL; Cloudflare Worker with a jest test.

pendingChange.title: OpenWeatherMap One Call API 2.5 deprecated (move to One Call 3.0)

source.quote: The One Call API, endpoint version 2.5, has been deprecated as of June 2024.

repos.migration: Change openWeatherEndpoint to https://api.openweathermap.org/data/3.0/onecall with the same lat/lon/units/exclude params and recheck the OpenWeather response types.

pendingChange.title: Twitch Helix GET /helix/users/follows removed in favour of GET /helix/channels/followers and /helix/channels/followed

source.quote: The Get Users Follows API endpoint has been removed.

repos.migration: Call GET /helix/channels/followers?broadcaster_id= (to_id becomes broadcaster_id). It needs a user token with moderator:read:followers instead of the app access token in FOLLOW_HEADERS. Map user_id/user_name instead of from_id/from_name, including the paged request at line 96.

pendingChange.title: FCM InstanceId server APIs (iid.googleapis.com topic subscription) deprecated

source.quote: Requests to these API will start failing after September 29, 2027.

repos.migration: Move the raw iid.googleapis.com rel/topics subscribe (legacy key= auth) and the firebase-admin 8.11.0 unsubscribeFromTopic (uses InstanceId) to the new FCM topic subscription API, e.g. firebase-admin >=14.5.0 for both.

pendingChange.title: Square Connect Node.js SDK (square-connect) deprecated and retired, replaced by the square package

source.quote: Square Node.js SDK is now GA and replaces the deprecated Connect Node.js SDK

repos.migration: Move to the square SDK: a Client with accessToken instead of ApiClient.instance + oauth2, catalogApi.listCatalog() reading result.objects, and camelCase models/fields (itemData.categoryId, modifierListInfo) instead of the snake_case item_data/category_id the plugin reads; tsc + jest test script; the quote is the tail of a 15-word sentence on that page.

pendingChange.title: Universal Analytics sunset (Measurement Protocol v1 /collect)

source.quote: Universal Analytics has sunset and is no longer available as of July 1, 2024.

repos.migration: Replace the v=1&tid=UA-... form POST to /collect with a GA4 Measurement Protocol JSON POST to /mp/collect?measurement_id=G-...&api_secret=... (needs a GA4 property).

pendingChange.title: OpenWeatherMap One Call API 2.5 deprecated (move to One Call 3.0)

source.quote: The One Call API, endpoint version 2.5, has been deprecated as of June 2024.

repos.migration: Point fetch_weather at /data/3.0/onecall (needs a One Call 3.0 subscription; the 2.5 page now points to endpoint 4.0) and update the URL asserted in weather/tests.py.

pendingChange.title: monday.com API 2023-10 removed items_by_column_values and boards { items }

source.quote: Breaking change: Removed the deprecated `items_by_column_values` and `items_by_multiple_column_values` objects, replaced with `items_page_by_column_values`

repos.migration: Rewrite find() to items_page_by_column_values and findAll() to boards { items_page { cursor items } } with cursor paging (also check the Int-typed $bId variables against the 2023-10 schema); used by src/index.js routes and src/synth.js; no API-Version header is sent; changelog entry dated 2023-07-10 (the sibling entry removes boards.items).

pendingChange.title: Azure AD Graph (graph.windows.net) retired in favour of Microsoft Graph

source.quote: Azure AD Graph will be fully retired.

repos.migration: Move /me/memberOf and /me calls to https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0 (@odata.nextLink paging, token resource https://graph.microsoft.com); the ADAL token call has to move with it.

pendingChange.title: Zoom webhook Verification Token replaced by secret-token signature (x-zm-signature) plus mandatory URL validation

source.quote: We are changing the way webhooks are verified and validated by Zoom.

repos.migration: In the Fastify POST /zoom handler, replace the Authorization == verification token check with an HMAC-SHA256 over v0:{x-zm-request-timestamp}:{body}, keyed with the webhook secret token and compared to x-zm-signature. Also answer endpoint.url_validation with plainToken/encryptedToken; the route's body schema requires payload.account_id/object and would reject that event. Has a prisma+tsc build script.
